overview.description: The iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long eth, short usd currency. The fund is an actively managed Trust, aiming to provide exposure to ether, the native token of Ethereum plus monthly income from staking, less Trust expenses. Ethereum is widely held in smart contracts across all block chains ETHB was launched on Feb 18, 2026 and is issued by BlackRock.
